notes.title: Yin & Yang
notes.content:
We added Yin & Yang themed world to our game. 

The new world consists of totally new 100 levels waiting for your clever mind and sharp sword to be solved.

You can access the new world by clicking the Yin & Yang symbol on the right side of the main menu, granted you have enough Sakura's collected to open it. 

Hope you enjoy the new levels and share your thoughts with us!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/3JajsqG.gif[/img]

notes.title: Soundtrack!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

The original soundtrack for SLICE is now released for free!
You can download it and as usual find the files in your local directory of the game. 
See the DLC page for the list of the tracks.

Hope you enjoy both the game and its free content, now including the soundtrack of the game.

notes.title: New FREE levels & technical update
notes.content:
Hello guys, we just launched the latest patch for the game, containing the following updates:

[*] Master of Meditation achievement now requires 30 restarts to be unlocked, instead of 10.

[*] You can now reset your level progress using the "Reset" button at the top left corner of the menu screen, under the Sakura counts. 

At the top of this - feel free to enjoy 25 new levels (coming with 10 new achievements) introducing new mechanics to further your Zen of SLICING. 
To access these levels, complete the first 5 worlds, then click the + icon at the button right side of the menu screen. 


Your feedback is most welcome, as always.
